messages:
Nadia C (docs): opening a small PR to add a drop-in Grafana panel and a few quick SDK examples for quota/rate docs. PR link will follow.
Omar B (analytics): good. can we include a minimal Loki query that surfaces burst events vs normal consumption? product wants to visualize spikes.
Nadia C (docs): yes — thinking two sample queries and a prebuilt panel json. will add example queries for: total tokens, burst_consumed, and quota_bucket.
Lina T (billing): also include a clear line about embeddings billing unit (one vector = 1 embedding unit) and how multi-vector responses are aggregated. last time customers confused per-512-token vs per-vector.
Ravi P (eng-runtime): FYI the runtime emits these headers now: `X-Redwood-Usage-Unit`, `X-Redwood-Quota-Bucket`, and `X-Redwood-Burst-Consumed`. older SDKs might surface `x-quota` differently. add a small migration note.
Nadia C (docs): putting a small migration snippet in the PR: "If you previously parsed `x-quota` update to `X-Redwood-Quota-Bucket` and check header casing in your client."
Omar B (analytics): sample Loki query suggestion: ```
{app="api"} | json | line_format "{{.headers.x_redwood_quota_bucket}} {{.headers.x_redwood_burst_consumed}} {{.tokens}}" | pattern "*"
```
Nadia C (docs): adding a JS SDK snippet and a Python snippet. JS snippet (v2): ```js
const resp = await client.generate({model: 'rwd-small', input: 'ping'});
console.log(resp.meta.headers['x-redwood-usage-unit']);
console.log(resp.meta.headers['x-redwood-burst-consumed']);
```
Ravi P (eng-runtime): small note: header keys are lowercased in some SDKs; recommend examples show both `resp.meta.headers['x-redwood-usage-unit']` and `resp.meta.headers['X-Redwood-Usage-Unit']` to avoid confusion.
Lina T (billing): can we also add a one-paragraph FAQ: "How do burst credits apply to per-token billing?" — short plain-language answer and a tiny numeric example (mobile app does 200 tokens baseline, spike consumes 300 burst credits = billed accordingly).
Nadia C (docs): will draft that FAQ and include a CSV-like matrix mapping: tier name, metered unit, committed capacity behavior, example. keeping it compact.
Import Bot: dashboard JSON uploaded to PR by Nadia C (docs): /analytics/examples/quota-grafana-panel.json
Omar B (analytics): I'll import and sanity-check the panel on staging grafana and confirm the Loki queries align.
Ravi P (eng-runtime): if you want me to run a synthetic spike to test `X-Redwood-Burst-Consumed` incrementing I can do one on staging later today.
Nadia C (docs): that would be great. I'll hold merge until you confirm. ETA EOD. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
